style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, cheerful sunny lighting. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Ruby: a small white rabbit with long floppy ears, a round fluffy tail, wearing a light blue pinafore dress, big round friendly eyes.
cover: Ruby the rabbit standing proudly next to an open wicker picnic basket in a sunny garden, holding a corner of a red-checkered cloth, excited smile, bright meadow and blue sky behind her.
pages: Ruby the rabbit looking thoughtfully at an empty wicker picnic basket sitting on a kitchen table, morning sunlight through a window, one paw on her chin wondering what to pack.
Ruby the rabbit standing on a small stool reaching up to a kitchen counter with a sandwich, a red apple, and a yellow cup lined up on it.
Ruby the rabbit in her cozy bedroom holding a jar of round cookies, with her small shoe and a big storybook lying nearby on the floor.
Ruby the rabbit happily closing the lid of a full wicker picnic basket, a sandwich, a red apple, a yellow cup, and cookies peeking out of the top, proud big smile.
Ruby the rabbit sitting on a red-checkered blanket under a big shady tree in a sunny park, happily eating her picnic, basket open beside her.
